description: This Kotlin source file defines the core registry for invoke commands and capabilities within the 'ai.openclaw.app.node' module. It contains data classes representing runtime flags, command and capability availability, and specifications. The 'InvokeCommandRegistry' object maintains registries of capability manifests, command specifications, and provides methods to retrieve command details, find commands by name, and determine available capabilities and commands based on runtime flags.

classes.name: NodeRuntimeFlags
classes.description: Holds boolean flags indicating the availability of various hardware and feature capabilities at runtime.

classes.name: InvokeCommandAvailability
classes.description: Enumeration of possible availability conditions for invoke commands, such as always available, camera enabled, or debug build.

classes.name: NodeCapabilityAvailability
classes.description: Enumeration of conditions specifying when a capability is available, such as always or based on certain hardware features.

classes.name: NodeCapabilitySpec
classes.description: Specification for a node capability, including its name and availability condition.

classes.name: InvokeCommandSpec
classes.description: Specification for an invoke command, including its name, whether it requires foreground execution, and its availability condition.

classes.name: InvokeCommandRegistry
classes.description: Singleton object that maintains the registry of capabilities and commands, and provides methods to query available capabilities and commands based on runtime flags.

methods.name: find
methods.description: Retrieves the command specification by its name if it exists.

methods.name: advertisedCapabilities
methods.description: Returns a list of capability names that are available given the current runtime flags.

methods.name: advertisedCommands
methods.description: Returns a list of command names that are available given the current runtime flags.
